1.sahih_international: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
1.pickthall: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,
1.yusuf_ali: Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-
1.shakir: Have We not expanded for you your breast,
1.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), have We not comforted your heart,
1.mohsin_khan: Have We not opened your breast for you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him))?
1.arberry: Did We not expand thy breast for thee

2.sahih_international: And We removed from you your burden
2.pickthall: And eased thee of the burden
2.yusuf_ali: And removed from thee thy burden
2.shakir: And taken off from you your burden,
2.mohsin_khan: And removed from you your burden,
2.arberry: and lift from thee thy burden,

3.sahih_international: Which had weighed upon your back
3.yusuf_ali: The which did gall thy back?-
3.shakir: Which pressed heavily upon your back,
3.muhammad_sarwar: which had been a heavy weight upon your back
3.arberry: the burden that weighed down thy back?

4.sahih_international: And raised high for you your repute.
4.yusuf_ali: And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)?
4.shakir: And exalted for you your esteem?
4.muhammad_sarwar: and granted you an exalted reputation?
4.arberry: Did We not exalt thy fame?

5.sahih_international: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
5.pickthall: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,
5.yusuf_ali: So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief:
5.muhammad_sarwar: After every difficulty there is relief.
5.mohsin_khan: So verily, with the hardship, there is relief,
5.arberry: So truly with hardship comes ease,

6.yusuf_ali: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.
6.muhammad_sarwar: Certainly, after every difficulty there comes relief.
6.mohsin_khan: Verily, with the hardship, there is relief (i.e. there is one hardship with two reliefs, so one hardship cannot overcome two reliefs).

7.sahih_international: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
7.pickthall: So when thou art relieved, still toil
7.yusuf_ali: Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard,
7.shakir: So when you are free, nominate.
7.muhammad_sarwar: When you are free from (your obligations), strive hard (to worship God)
7.mohsin_khan: So when you have finished (from your occupation), then stand up for Allah's worship (i.e. stand up for prayer).
7.arberry: So when thou art empty, labour,

8.sahih_international: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
8.pickthall: And strive to please thy Lord.
8.yusuf_ali: And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention.
8.shakir: And make your Lord your exclusive object.
8.muhammad_sarwar: and be devoted to your Lord's service.
8.mohsin_khan: And to your Lord (Alone) turn (all your intentions and hopes and) your invocations.
8.arberry: and let thy Lord be thy Quest.
